item.tib: zab mo snyan brgyud rin po che gdams pa zhi gcod kyi ting 'dzin nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud 'di ni/ mtshan ldan sman gong bas/ rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i seng ge la rgyud (brgyud)/ des se btsun tshul dar la/ des mkhas btsun gzhon tshul/ des mkhas btsun la/ des yon tan seng ge la/ des nam mkha' blo ldan la/ des hor sgoms (sgom) 'dul rin/ des grags pa ye shes la rgyud (brgyud/)de nas rim bzhin bdag gi mos pas zhus so//
